title: Claude Code神话破灭？大量用户正在取消订阅
content: Claude Code's growth has stalled dramatically, with its monthly recurring revenue growth rate plummeting to 5.2% by August 2026 after reaching $15.12 billion. The decline stems from multiple factors: saturated developer market, poor reception of its Cowork product, and a controversial invisible watermark feature that embeds AI markers into all generated content, angering programmers and writers concerned about code contamination and legal risks. Users also complain about restrictive usage quotas and inconsistent performance of the Fable 5 model. Meanwhile, rival OpenAI Codex is growing four times faster at 20.8%, absorbing fleeing Claude subscribers with better IDE integration, no watermarks, and fewer restrictions. The situation exposes broader challenges facing AI companies transitioning from hype-driven growth to sustainable business models.

The framework maintains its "everything is a plugin" design philosophy.

title: Citizens Build, Agents Execute, Experts Govern
content: AI enables non-engineers to build functional software quickly, but this differs sharply from enterprise software engineering. The future: citizens create ideas, agents execute code, and experts ensure production-worthy governance.
